ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (>95% black/dark grey); high-intensity pixels (white) are sparse, localized to terminal clusters and surface abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is uniform dark pigmentation; distinct high-contrast white contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes; thin, high-intensity linear pixel strings are distributed across the medial-lateral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute-angled V-shaped central notch with a deep pixel-depth indentation dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-level variations (serrations) along the entire trailing boundary; multiple distinct peaks and valleys are visible, particularly on the inner margins of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges of both lobes, tapering into sharp, dorsally-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups are detected at the extreme distal terminals of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, thin, light-colored linear pixel disruptions are visible; a prominent diagonal mark is located on the right lobe, with shorter multi-directional marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive serrated damage and irregular chipping along the entire trailing edge boundary; significant high-intensity scarring and mineralization clusters at both lobe tips; visible linear rake marks on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Exaggerated sharp, attenuated distal tips oriented vertically.
